definitions.gloss: luminous body; light-emitting object; light source
definitions.explanation: Any object that produces or emits light, whether natural (such as stars or fireflies) or artificial (such as LEDs or fluorescent tubes).

examples.japanese: ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{巨大|きょだい}→巨大：02586_kyodai⟧な{発光体|はっこうたい}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: The sun is a massive luminous body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暗闇|くらやみ}→暗闇：12859_kurayami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{発光体|はっこうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: A small luminous object was visible in the darkness.

examples.japanese: ホタル⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自然界|しぜんかい}→自然界：15255_shizenkai⟧⟦における→〜における：21802_niokeru⟧{発光体|はっこうたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表的|だいひょうてき}→代表的：05670_daihyouteki⟧な⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧だ。
examples.english: Fireflies are a classic example of luminous bodies in nature.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{発光|はっこう}→発光：17472_hakkou⟧ (luminescence; light emission) and ⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ (body; object). Used in scientific, technical, and descriptive contexts to refer to anything that emits light.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧{発光体|はっこうたい}: natural luminous body
- ⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧{発光体|はっこうたい}: artificial light source
- {発光体|はっこうたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明|あか}るさ: brightness of a light source

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {光源|こうげん}: light source — more common in everyday and technical use
- {蛍光体|けいこうたい}: fluorescent material — specifically a substance that glows when excited by radiation
- LED: LED (light-emitting diode) — a specific modern technology for light emission
